notes.notes:
Introducing The Adventures of TED and the Lost Magic Crystals, the epic 2.5D platformer adventure game that will take you on an unforgettable journey!

Lest play as young TED as he embarks on a quest to find the lost magic crystals, essential for saving the squirrel kingdom. While TED may not start as a traditional hero, the challenges he faces along the way will test his courage and determination.
Features:

    *31 levels packed with adventure
    *Epic boss battles that will keep you on the edge of your seat
    *Cinematic action sequences that bring the story to life
    *Hidden items and secrets to discover and collect
    *Unlockable in-game achievements to show off your skills
    *Full compatibility with Xbox & PlayStation controllers for smooth gameplay

With its nostalgic 3D low poly graphics and classic gameplay, The Adventures of TED is a love letter to the golden era of console gaming.

notes.title: The Adventure WEEK LONG DEAL! Offer ends 23 January
notes.notes:
The Adventures of TED and the Lost Magic Crystals is a casual 2.5D Lowpoly Platformer Adventure game,
A story about Young TED who is interested in finding the lost magic crystals, the source of life for the squirrel's kingdom. TED is interested because of the reward, of course...
He doesn't want to be a hero.
But the journey is not easy, Young TED must face many obstacles along the way.

• Consists of 31 levels

• Fight giant boss

• Cool cinematic and action

• Items or Secret to find and collect

• Unlock All in-game Achievements


Classic 2.5D Platformer Adventure game from RgamesID, Bringing you a nostalgic look to the Golden era of world console games with 3D Low poly Graphics.
